Question 4
?

If you exercise regularly, then you'll improve your health.

Which statement is logically equivalent to the conditional statement above?

a
Don't exercise regularly, or you won't improve your health.
b
Either you exercise regularly, or you'll improve your health.
c
Either you exercise regularly, or you won't improve your health.
d
Either you do not exercise regularly, or you'll improve your health.
e
Don't exercise regularly, and you won't improve your health.
